items.title: MoPET：用于统一医学图像分类的参数高效专家混合
items.originalTitle: MoPET: Parameter-Efficient Mixture-of-Experts for Unified Medical Image Classification
items.summary: 医学图像分类面临临床异质性，参数高效微调（PEFT）可避免过拟合并共享网络容量，但通常训练独立适配器存在负迁移。本文提出MoPET，使用稀疏路由器将输入路由到低秩PEFT专家，共享容量并限制跨域梯度冲突。在MedMNIST基准上，PEFT平均准确率从86.50%提至88.97%；单个MoPET模型整合四个异构数据集，准确率达93.46%，优于最佳独立适配器；与辅助数据集协同训练可将目标准确率从81.58%提至83.58%。代码已公开。
items.abstract: Adapting deep learning models to profound clinical heterogeneity typically relies on parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) to avoid the severe overfitting associated with full end-to-end network updates. Although PEFT successfully navigates limited data scenarios, it inherently forces the training of a separate, isolated adapter for every specific diagnostic task. 提出MoPET方法，使用混合专家（MoE）结构，通过学习到的稀疏路由器将输入分配到低秩PEFT专家子集，共享跨数据集容量并限制梯度冲突。

items.title: 超越检索：用于多模态智能体的分析记忆
items.originalTitle: Beyond Retrieval: Analytic Memory for Multimodal Agents
items.summary: 长期多模态记忆不仅需要检索相关信息，还需计算累积观测。现有系统侧重检索记忆，本文提出分析记忆作为补充抽象，将重复出现的多模态观测组织为可查询结构，支持过滤、聚合、排序和时序比较。框架AdaMM联合支持检索和分析记忆，自动提取属性-值观测并物化。在MemEye和MemGallery基准上，AdaMM性能分别提升11.3%和7.3%。
items.abstract: Long-term multimodal memory must support not only retrieving relevant information but also computing over observations accumulated across interactions. Existing systems largely emphasize \emph{retrieval memory}, organizing interaction histories through summaries and indexes to return query-relevant information at multiple granularities, from high-level abstractions to underlying records. In this paper, we formulate \emph{analytic memory} as a complementary abstraction that organizes recurring multimodal observatio…
keyFacts: 如何超越简单的检索记忆，支持对累积多模态观测的分析性计算？
提出AdaMM框架，联合支持检索和分析记忆；提取带有来源链的属性-值观测，发现重复字段结构并物化；推理时记忆感知规划器将查询分解为检索和分析操作并路由到相应工具。
在两个基准MemEye和MemGallery上，AdaMM分别将性能提升11.3%和7.3%。

items.originalTitle: AgentHPOBench: A Benchmark For Evaluating LLM Agents as Sequential Hyperparameter Optimizers
items.summary: LLM作为自主科学智能体需评估其实验能力，现有基准多关注静态代码生成或最终答案，未直接评估智能体解释实验证据并指导超参数决策的能力。本文提出AgentHPOBench，包含30个可执行机器学习任务，智能体基于累计配置、指标和日志顺序提出有效配置。评估12种智能体和传统HPO基线，结果显示当前智能体显示一定优化能力，但持续迭代改进、复杂日志诊断和一致进步方面仍有局限。
items.abstract: As LLMs evolve from code completion systems into autonomous scientific agents, evaluating their ability to conduct experiments has become increasingly important. Existing benchmarks typically focus on static code generation, paper replication, or final answer correctness, but do not directly assess whether agents can interpret experimental evidence and use it to guide subsequent hyperparameter decisions. To address this gap, we introduce AgentHPOBench, a sequential benchmark comprising 30 executable machine learni…

构建AgentHPOBench顺序基准，包含30个可执行任务，智能体在验证基线后执行多次顺序干预，观察累计配置、指标和日志后提出新配置。

items.originalTitle: A Human-Centered Validation of the Explainability-Performance Coefficient

items.title: MOT-SR：具有大型语言模型的多目标工具增强科学方程发现
items.originalTitle: MOT-SR: Multi-Objective Tool-Augmented Scientific Equation Discovery with Large Language Models
items.summary: 符号回归从观测数据发现解析方程，但现有基于LLM的方法缺乏数据分析机制且只用拟合误差作为单一目标，忽视复杂性和泛化导致局部最优。本文提出MOT-SR框架，集成外部分析工具提取结构先验，通过多目标评估模块联合优化准确性、复杂性和泛化，维护动态帕累托前沿。MOT-SR采用元策略生成器和方程生成器协同工作，闭环迭代。在40个标准任务上优于现有方法；在极端质量比旋近轨道建模中取得最低轨迹积分误差。

While recent Large Language Model (LLM) based approaches show promise, they face two limitations. First, they lack data analysis mechanisms for uncovering variable dependencies, which reduces the efficiency of equation discovery. Second, most methods rely on single-objective evaluation focused solely on fitting error. This neglect of structural complexity and generalization often…
keyFacts: 如何利用LLM和工具增强符号回归，同时优化准确性、复杂性和泛化？
提出MOT-SR框架，集成外部分析工具提取结构先验，通过多目标评估模块维护帕累托前沿，采用元策略生成器和方程生成器协同闭环优化。

items.originalTitle: ARB: A Matched Authorship-Rewriting Benchmark Dataset for AI-Text Detector Evaluation
items.summary: 标准AI文本检测基准比较人类写作与LLM直接生成的文本。我们引入ARB基准，包含1800个人类源文本及四个生成器，每个源有四类变体。评估五个检测器，发现FastDetectGPT和Binoculars在直接LLM文本上检测率高，但对LLM重写的人类文本检测率大幅下降，表明传统基准不能预测重写场景下的性能。
items.abstract: Standard AI-text detection benchmarks compare human-written text against text generated directly by large language models (LLMs). While prior work has shown that rewriting and paraphrasing can degrade detector performance, it remains unclear whether performance measured on this conventional benchmark predicts detector behavior when human-authored content is rewritten by an LLM. To address this gap, we introduce Authorship-Rewriting Benchmark (ARB), built from 1,800 human source texts (600 each from XSum, WritingPr…
keyFacts: 标准AI文本检测基准的性能是否能预测人类文本被LLM重写后的检测器行为？
构建Authorship-Rewriting Benchmark (ARB)，包含1800个人类源文本和四个开源生成器，生成四种匹配变体（HUMAN、Free-LLM、H2L、LLM2L），在1%假阳性率下评估五个检测器。
FastDetectGPT和Binoculars检测直接LLM文本的召回率分别为91.2%和93.5%，但对LLM重写的人类文本仅30.8%和15.1%，下降60-78个百分点；LLM重写LLM文本时下降较小。RADAR类似，BERT-Defense和RoBERTa-Defense在所有情况下召回率低于3%。

items.summary: 模仿学习中，交互式查询专家和价值估计通常提高性能。我们证明专家交互放松了表征要求：仅需建模专家价值函数，无需建模其策略。提出算法OVI，统计高效且计算高效。负结果证明交互必要性。实验显示OVI优于基线，尤其当学习者网络远不如专家时。
items.abstract: Imitation learning (IL)---training an agent to replicate expert behavior from demonstrations---underpins applications from robotics to language model training. Standard approaches such as Behavior Cloning (BC) are known to suffer from compounding errors and performance plateaus, particularly when the learner cannot perfectly represent the expert's policy (as is typical, e.g., in distillation). Two interventions are widely understood empirically to improve performance: querying the expert interactively along the le…
keyFacts: 在模仿学习中，在线交互何时以及如何改进性能？其背后的表征权衡是什么？
介绍交互式在线模仿学习算法OVI，要求学习者能表示专家价值函数，并提供线性最大化预言；结合负结果证明交互必要性。
OVI在统计和计算上高效，且在经验上优于离线策略、交互策略和离线价值方法，最大收益出现在学习者网络表达能力远低于专家时。

items.originalTitle: HAM-VLN: Harnessing Hierarchical Agentic Memory for Zero-Shot Vision-and-Language Navigation
items.summary: 我们提出HAM-VLN，一种决策耦合的代理记忆，为机器人提供持久的深度接地世界图。同一模型调用中记录语义和反思信息，最近航点保持逐字，旧历史通过相关性和拓扑扩展进入上下文。无需额外LLM调用，上下文长度减少65%以上。在VLN-CE R2R、RxR和HM3D-v2 ObjectNav上分别达到61.0%、52.7%和79.7%的成功率，无需训练。
items.abstract: Vision-and-language navigation (VLN) enables robots to follow instructions in previously unseen environments. Recently, a training-free paradigm has emerged: the robot queries a multimodal LLM to understand its observations and plan the next action. However, long-horizon navigation based on either image streams or dense map inevitably introduces a growing memory and reasoning bottleneck. We present HAM-VLN, a decision-coupled, agent-authored memory that equips the robot with a persistent, depth-grounded world grap…

HAM-VLN在无需训练的情况下，VLN-CE R2R SR 61.0%，RxR SR 52.7%，HM3D-v2 ObjectNav SR 79.7%，且上下文长度减少超过65%。

items.summary: 研究显示，围绕单星的温暖亚土星主要对齐，而热亚土星经常错位，两群体差异在3.2σ水平。因两者均绕冷恒星运行，避免了T_eff-λ依赖的不确定性。结合温暖木星的对齐，表明自旋-轨道错位出现在潮汐圆化高效的近距热木星类似物区域。错位过渡发生在更宽轨道间距，支持高偏心率迁移产生错位。
items.abstract: In this work, we show that warm sub-Saturns orbiting single stars are predominantly aligned, in contrast to hot sub-Saturns, which are frequently misaligned, with the two populations differing at the 3.2$σ$ level. Because both populations are observed around cool stars, they are free from the ambiguity introduced by the $T_{\rm eff}$-$λ$ dependence. Together with the established alignment of warm Jupiters, this demonstrates, among single-star systems, that spin-orbit misalignment arises specifically in the close-i…
keyFacts: 单星系统中温暖亚土星的自旋-轨道对齐状态如何？
统计分析温暖和热亚土星的观测数据，比较对齐分布，计算过渡轨道间距。
温暖亚土星对齐，热亚土星错位，差异3.2σ；过渡间距比亚星宽，支持高偏心率迁移。

items.originalTitle: Quantum Inspired QUBO Assisted ALNS for Reliability Driven Hurricane Restoration of Distribution Networks
items.summary: 本文提出量子启发二次无约束二值优化辅助自适应大邻域搜索框架，用于飓风后配电系统修复调度。在IEEE 123节点测试馈线上评估，100 m/s风况下，平均系统中断持续时间指数和未供电能量降低2.24%，恢复时间缩短50.71%，相比经典ALNS。QUBO辅助在严重损坏造成更大组合空间时最有价值。

This paper presents a quantum inspired quadratic unconstrained binary optimization (QUBO) assisted adaptive large neighborhood search (ALNS) framework. At each restoration stage, a local CPU simulated annealing sampler ranks individual repairs and multi job combinations near the energized frontier. A deterministic decoder preserves crew truck logistics, enforces f…

items.abstract: Development of specialized imaging and spectroscopy states in transmission electron microscopy is needed for novel applications, such as flexible momentum-resolved high energy-resolution spectroscopy. This task is complicated by the need to align and configure many different lenses, and by ambiguity as to the locations of various imaging and diffraction planes, which are often not well documented. Here we develop a versatile digital twin for simulating the electron beam trajectory throughout an electron microscope…

items.title: 无泄漏检测单元的稳定子码量子比特丢失推断
items.originalTitle: Qubit Loss Inference with Stabilizer Codes without Leakage Detection Units
items.summary: 研究能否从标准重复稳定子测量的综合征数据推断量子比特丢失，而无需泄漏检测单元（LDU）。在涉及丢失量子比特的非纠缠门模型下，推导了丢失可检测的充分条件，基于支持去除后的稳定子检查反对易。将推断问题表述为最大似然和最小集合覆盖问题，并用贪婪算法求解。在旋转表面码上模拟，推断和自适应协议相比LDU基线降低逻辑错误率并减少开销。
items.abstract: Qubit loss occurs when the physical carrier of a qubit leaves the computational system without directly revealing the event's location. Such errors are a major obstacle to fault-tolerant quantum computation on platforms including photonic, neutral-atom, and trapped-ion systems. Loss locations are commonly identified using additional hardware operations such as leakage-detection units (LDUs), which introduce space-time overhead and may themselves become a source of error.
